title: Ender Pearl Activator Mod
description: This mod adds an item, which allows the player to activate a suspended ender pearl.
body:
The Ender Pearl **Activation** Mod allows you to craft an **item** called the **activator** item, which **activates** a suspended or flying **ender pearl**.
This is peticularly usefull if you play in a single player world or no one except for you is currently online.

![Basic showcase of the mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f3e0989c65edaa14679e1fa7c13b7a3ef33fb14.png)

The Teleportation works across dimensions, BUT the **chunk** containing the ender pearl has to be **loaded**. You can do so by installing a chunk loader mod like 
[https://modrinth.com/mod/load-my-chunks](https://modrinth.com/mod/load-my-chunks).

The activator item is crafted like this:
![Crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ad77043a82eda04f0c58853479fff1daa529928.png)
